title: Topic 8: Time, Days & Dates - Writing
description: Handwritten task (Mode B): write on paper and upload a photo.
canDoStatement: Tell the time, say days and months, give simple dates

writingTask.writingPrompt:
THIRD PAPER TASK. Student writes BY HAND on paper, then
uploads a photo / scan / PDF.

TASK: Write out your weekly schedule by hand.

Instructions shown in app:
  1. On paper, write the 7 days of the week, Monday to
     Sunday, one per line.
  2. For at least 4 days, add one activity + a time or
     part of day.
     Example line format: Monday - I study English at
     eight o'clock. (format hint only - content is yours)
  3. Take a photo and upload it.

Minimum requirements:
  - All 7 days written, in order, spelled correctly
  - 4+ days have an activity (T7 verbs) + time expression
  - at / on / in used correctly at least twice
